literal_meaning: The analogy of an ant-line forming.
explanation: This is a visual comparison rather than a rebuke. The dictionary describes a place where many people gather and compares their movement to a line of ants. The eye follows the continuing file of people. The source does not turn the image into a lesson about obedience, hard work or unquestioning conformity.
meaning_odia: ଅନେକ ଲୋକ ଏକାଠି ହୋଇ ଧାର ବାନ୍ଧି ଚାଲୁଥିବା ଦୃଶ୍ୟକୁ ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ଧାର ସହ ତୁଳନା କରାଯାଏ। ଅଭିଧାନର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଏହି ଦୃଶ୍ୟଗତ ସାମ୍ୟକୁ ଧରେ। ଆଖି ଆଗରେ ଲୋକଙ୍କ ଚାଲିବାର ଧାରଟି ଲମ୍ବିଯାଏ। ଏଠାରେ ପରିଶ୍ରମ କିମ୍ବା ଶୃଙ୍ଖଳାର ଉପଦେଶ ଯୋଡ଼ିବା ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ।
english_summary: A moving crowd is pictured as a line of ants.
odia_summary: ଲୋକଙ୍କ ଚଳନ୍ତି ଧାର ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ଧାର ପରି ଦିଶେ।
narrative_credit: Explanation adapted and expanded from ପିମ୍ପୁଡ଼ି — Odia Wiktionary.

title: A stream of people like a line of ants
usage_example: Looking down from a terrace as people file towards a fair, someone remarks, “ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ଧାର ଲାଗିବା ନ୍ୟାୟ।” (Original imagined use.)
